text: The authors describe their debate protocol, two GPT-4o debaters arguing opposite positions over three fixed rounds with judges able to question either debater, and state that it builds on previous interactive debate designs [30, 31, 36]. They pair it with a single-consultant baseline arguing an assigned position.
